node.description: The Genericom production environment dimension. All Genericom-owned nodes and edges are tagged with {"tap.env": "genericom-prod"} so the demonstration environment can be sliced out of the graph. Genericom is a fictional customer-facing web application stack used to exercise TAP visualization features; it does not represent a real AWS account.
